messages.subject: Testing individual path (multiple group SEM)
parts:
Hi all.

model = "
quality =~ q1 + q2 + q3
value =~ v1 + v3 + v4 
womr =~ wom1 + wom2 + wom3
womr ~ quality + value"

In this simple mode, how can I constrain individual path coefficient (womr~quality and womr~value) across group?
The structural model was constrained by simply following: fit = sem(model, data = data, group = "luxury", group.equal = c("regressions"))
By applying the syntax, I tried:
fit2 = sem(model, data = data, group = "luxury", group.equal = c("womr ~ innovativeness"))
But, it is not working....HaHaHa
I look forward to receiving your invaluable advice!!
Thanks for your time
Sincerely,
Yonghwan Chang

messages.author: b048c97bee0de8a7
messages.subject: Re: Testing individual path (multiple group SEM)
parts:
Dear Lavaan users,

I am Yonghwan who asked the question above. I found an answer from "lavaan: an R package for structural equation modeling and more Version 0.4-7 (BETA)"
In the specific case of my model, the answer should be fit2 = sem(model, data = data, group = "luxury", group.equal = c("regressions"), group.partial = c("womr ~ quality"))
I am posting this note for future users.
Thanks
Sincerely,
Yonghwan Chang
